'''Jordan Mickey''' (born July 9, 1994) is an American [[basketball]] player who recently ended his college career at [[Louisiana State University]].  Mickey, a 6'8" [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]] from [[Dallas, Texas]], is considered one of the top players in college basketball and a likely second-round pick in the [[2015 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web | last = Mickles | first = Sheldon | title = LSU forwards Mickey, Martin projected as second-round picks | work = [[Baton Rouge Advocate]] | date = January 14, 2015 | url = http://theadvocate.com/sports/lsu/11532363-123/lsus-jordan-mickey-jarell-martin | accessdate = March 10, 2015}}</ref>

==High school career==
Considered a four-star recruit by [[ESPN.com]], Mickey was listed as the No. 12 power forward and the No. 38 player in the nation in 2013.<ref>[http://espn.go.com/college-sports/basketball/recruiting/player/_/id/104932/jordan-mickey Jordan Mickey Recruiting Profile]</ref>
